question: Which keyboard shortcut opens File Explorer (previously known as Windows Explorer) in Windows 10?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Win + E**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Win + E** is the keyboard shortcut to open File Explorer in Windows 10.
 
• File Explorer, previously known as Windows Explorer, is a file management application that is part of the Windows operating system.
 
• Using the **Win + E** shortcut quickly opens File Explorer, allowing users to manage files and folders efficiently.
